children: Ligand acquired royalty and milestone payment rights to Santen’s Ryjunea for a $23 million upfront payment.
Paid $23 million upfront to acquire ascending tiered royalty and milestone rights from Sydnexis.
Acquired rights cover Ryjunea net sales in Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA).
Royalties are tiered from low-double-digit to high-teens on Ryjunea net sales in EMEA.
Ryjunea is the first approved pharmacologic treatment in the EU and UK to slow pediatric myopia.
